AccountDecision.description:
The outcome of an admin's decision on a dealer or expert application (common/account_status.py), returned by
both routes that decide one. `email_delivered` says whether the applicant's decision email reached the mail server
(SRDS §9); False when email is off in this environment or the send failed, so the admin can follow up.
AccountDecision.title: AccountDecision

AdjustStockRequest.description:
`quantity` is the size of the change for addition, restock, sale and reduction, so it must be positive (a
restock of -1 used to be recorded as +1); for adjustment and correction it is the new stock, so zero is allowed.
AdjustStockRequest.title: AdjustStockRequest

AdjustmentInput.description: A manual correction (SRDS §23): always with a reason, so the ledger explains every change.
AdjustmentInput.title: AdjustmentInput

AdminQueues.description:
What waits for the admin (SRDS §14), from admin_queue_counts(): submitted dealer and expert applications, open or
investigating reports, disputed orders, and consultations open for over a week without an outcome.
AdminQueues.title: AdminQueues

AiActivity.description: The AI module at a glance for the last `window_days` days (SRDS §37). Counts only; no image, no farmer.
AiActivity.title: AiActivity

AiActivityDay.description: One UTC day of the activity window.
AiActivityDay.title: AiActivityDay

AiCaseSummary.description:
The AI result attached to a consultation (SRDS §34-§35). Advisory only (BR-13): the expert's own answer is a
separate `ConsultationAssessment`, never written into this report.
AiCaseSummary.title: AiCaseSummary

AuditEventNameEntry.description: One audit event name and the label the audit screen shows for it (SRDS §51).
AuditEventNameEntry.title: AuditEventNameEntry

ConsultationAssessment.description:
The Expert Assessment, stored apart from the AI report and always labelled as the expert's. Append-only: a later
assessment supersedes an earlier one, nothing is edited.
ConsultationAssessment.title: ConsultationAssessment

Dashboard.description: SRDS §18: the figures, the recent activity, the alerts and the stock trend.
Dashboard.title: Dashboard

DealerApplicationInput.description: The business half of a dealer's application. The lengths match the table's checks.
DealerApplicationInput.title: DealerApplicationInput

DecideAccountRequest.description:
An admin's decision on a pending dealer (SRDS §8, §12). A rejection carries the reason the applicant will read
on their Application Status screen, so it must say something (decide_account_status() enforces the same).
DecideAccountRequest.title: DecideAccountRequest

DiseaseKnowledge.description: One row of `disease_knowledge`: the advisory text for one model class (SRDS §34-§35).
DiseaseKnowledge.title: DiseaseKnowledge

DiseaseKnowledgeUpdate.description:
An admin's edit of one entry. class_label is the model's own label and is_healthy follows from it, so neither
is editable; review fields change only through the review route.
DiseaseKnowledgeUpdate.title: DiseaseKnowledgeUpdate

DiseaseReport.description:
The AI report contract (plan A6): what the farmer and the assigned expert see for one prediction.

The text comes from `disease_knowledge`, never from code, so an agronomist's review changes what is shown without a
release. `review_status` says whether that text has been reviewed yet, and `disclaimer` is on every report
because BR-13 makes every AI result advisory and routes it to an expert.
DiseaseReport.title: DiseaseReport

ExpertApplicantRef.description: The account half of an expert's application, for the admin (SRDS §12).
ExpertApplicantRef.title: ExpertApplicantRef

ExpertForAdmin.description: The admin reads add the account, the verification history (one record per submission) and the documents.
ExpertForAdmin.title: ExpertForAdmin

FarmCropWithCrop.description: Reads embed the crop; create and update return the bare row.
FarmCropWithCrop.title: FarmCropWithCrop

InventoryItemWithListing.description: The list and detail reads embed the linked listing; create, update and adjust return the bare row.
InventoryItemWithListing.title: InventoryItemWithListing

ListingWithRelations.description: Browse, detail and moderation reads embed the category and the owner; create and update do not.
ListingWithRelations.title: ListingWithRelations

PredictionRecord.description: A stored `disease_predictions` row, kept as history.
PredictionRecord.title: PredictionRecord

ProblemDetail.description: RFC 9457 problem details. `code` is a stable machine-readable identifier; `title` is English text.
ProblemDetail.title: ProblemDetail

ProductView.description: A product with where its stock is and the marketplace listings it feeds (D8).
ProductView.title: ProductView

PurchaseUpdateInput.description: Edits a draft purchase. `items`, when sent, replaces every line.
PurchaseUpdateInput.title: PurchaseUpdateInput

ReconciliationReport.description: SRDS §25 over the whole ledger (it must add up to the stock on hand, so it has no period), unbalanced first.
ReconciliationReport.title: ReconciliationReport

RegisterDocumentRequest.description:
A file the applicant has uploaded to their own folder of their role's bucket, to attach to the application.
The size and type are read from Storage by the database (fill_application_document), never taken from here.
RegisterDocumentRequest.title: RegisterDocumentRequest

RequiredDocument.description: One document an applicant of a role is asked for (SRDS §7: the list is configurable, by an admin).
RequiredDocument.title: RequiredDocument

RequiredDocumentInput.description: A new document applicants of a role are asked for (SRDS §7: configurable). `code` is a stable machine name.
RequiredDocumentInput.title: RequiredDocumentInput

RequiredDocumentUpdate.description: A change to one entry. It is never deleted, only retired (`active: false`): sent documents point at it.
RequiredDocumentUpdate.title: RequiredDocumentUpdate

ReviewVerificationRequest.description:
An admin's decision on a pending expert application (SRDS §11, §12). Suspension is no longer a decision: it
is the account's suspension (PATCH /admin/users/{id}/suspend), like every other role's. A rejection carries the
reason the expert reads on their Application Status screen.
ReviewVerificationRequest.title: ReviewVerificationRequest

SalesSplitReport.description: Marketplace orders (ZARAILINK_ORDER) against local sales (LOCAL_SALE), net of any returned units.
SalesSplitReport.title: SalesSplitReport

StockInInput.description: Stock In (SRDS §22-§23): new stock arriving by hand. Purchases from a supplier go through /purchases.
StockInInput.title: StockInInput

StockOutInput.description:
Stock Out (SRDS §22-§23): a local sale, a loss, or own use (OTHER). A loss or own use needs a reason, as
record_movement enforces; checked here too so the dealer gets a field error, not a database one.
StockOutInput.title: StockOutInput

app__common__schemas__Location.description: The structured place stored as jsonb on farms, stores, listings and experts.
app__common__schemas__Location.title: Location
